stories.headline: upGrad Enters Enterprise Advisory With Launch Of upGrad Next
stories.script: Turning to India. upGrad has launched upGrad Next, an enterprise advisory practice that combines consulting with the edtech company’s existing workforce skilling and hiring services The launch puts upGrad in a position to advise companies on how to restructure teams and prepare employees for AI adoption, then help implement those changes Four former Deloitte and EY executives will lead the practice as managing directors, with more senior leaders expected to join in the coming weeks Edtech unicorn upGrad has launched upGrad Next, an enterprise advisory practice that will help companies restructure their organisations and prepare their employees for AI adoption. The new vertical will advise senior executives on organisational structure, hiring, employee compensation, and workforce development.
